reason: Both are diversified US manufacturers of building products sold through distributors and direct to contractors. Carlisle's core is roofing membranes, insulation and weatherproofing (building envelope). CSW's shown lines are HVAC/plumbing trade products, architectural building components, fire and smoke protection, railings, and industrial lubricants. Customers overlap in commercial building contractors, but the products do not clearly overlap. Carlisle's non-building lines also differ from CSW's, so this is adjacent.
